brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Provide tidy storage for sewing supplies
requirements.evidence: 3 cells with bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments), bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments), bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full (open tray). Bins provide divided compartments for small notions and open area for larger tools/fabric. Shown with workshop props (heap-screws-div3, heap-nuts-div3, tweezers, solder-reel) as stand-ins for bobbins/buttons/pins/thread – no dedicated sewing props exist in catalog. Visible from above (look polar 10).
3x full hex bases at (0,0,0), (1,0,0), (0,1,0) capped on all open faces and lockJoints bolted. ~353mm across, 1600g print. Bins hang on rims without fixings.

finish.summary: 3-cell hexagonal caddy with divided bins (3-compartment, 2-compartment, and full open tray) capped and bolted. Staged with small-part props to illustrate sewing notions; viewed from above props are visible. Mesh clear, no errors.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build provides a compact 3-cell tidy for small sewing notions on a desk or shelf.

* 3 hexagonal cells capped and bolted: stable cluster
* bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 – 3-compartment tray for smalls (pins, buttons, bobbins) shown with heap-screws-div3 / heap-nuts-div3 / tweezers
* bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 – 2-compartment tray for thread/reels and tape, shown with solder-reel props as thread spools
* bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full – large open tray for fabric scissors/tape measure/ruler etc, shown with solder-reel; props sit low under the rim so best viewed from above

Props are illustrative – catalog has no specific sewing scissors/thread props so workshop analogues used. All meshes clear, no prop warnings.
